name: useTime
summary: Motion for React hook that returns elapsed time in milliseconds every frame, for perpetual animations.
description: useTime returns a motion value that updates once per frame with the duration, in milliseconds, since it was first created. It is useful for generating perpetual animations and can be used directly or composed with other motion value hooks such as useTransform. The framer.com docs URL now redirects to the Framer developers hub; the hook's documentation lives at motion.dev/docs/react-use-time.
